prompt:
Redesign the custom playing-card back in image 1 to be radically more schematic, flat, understated and sparse. Image 2 is the PRIMARY STYLE AND COMPOSITION reference: the original Machi Koro card backs, especially the pale blue-green version on the right. Match that visual language closely: flat frontal geometric building symbols, small naive shapes, an extremely thin off-white angular meandering road, lots of pale background, no realistic perspective. Preserve only the recognizable building TYPES and a few silhouette cues from image 1, not its detailed rendering, density, street layout or lighting.
Output ONE portrait 1024x1536 flat card back, not two cards and not a photograph. Uniform very pale dusty sage-blue background, narrow ivory outer border with softly rounded inner corners. No strong blue border. Low saturation, gentle restrained contrast; a quiet supporting card back that never competes with card faces.
Build a sparse charming town pattern across four loosely staggered bands, like reference 2. Use flat front-facing icons, not isometric models: a beige-gray five-storey panel house with simple rectangular windows and two muted sage balcony strips; a tiny beige shawarma building with a muted terracotta awning and small simple shawarma pictogram; a short row of three brick garages with terracotta and sage doors and one dark open doorway; a compact blue-gray refinery made of only 3 vertical towers, two round tanks and a few pipe lines; a dusty burgundy karaoke building with one tiny ivory microphone pictogram. Can repeat a small panel block or garage to balance spacing. Keep all icons small enough for roughly 55-65 percent of the inner canvas to remain open background. Mix two larger and several small building shapes across the four bands, with a continuous thin ivory path gently turning at right angles around them as in image 2. The path must be an abstract line, not a paved street: NO asphalt, lanes, lane markings, curbs, sidewalks or vanishing point.
Only a few stylized trees made from circles/ovals and thin trunks and 2-3 tiny geometric car symbols. Optional two tiny tire-swan symbols near the panel house, only if visually simple. No people, rendered vegetation, shrubs, realistic smoke, lighting glow, dramatic shadows, brick textures, rust, scenic sky, gradients, realistic materials, dimensional outlines or cinematic rendering. Buildings should be clean blocks of 3-5 muted flat colors, with minimal window rhythm, thin or no outlines. Colors: pale sage-blue ground, warm cream, dusty slate, gray olive, faded terracotta, muted mauve. Desaturate and lighten compared with both references. Very subtle paper grain allowed, no distress.
No title, text, letters, numbers, brand logos, flag logo, coin symbols or watermark. All main forms comfortably inside border. This is a quiet mid-century geometric illustrated card-back pattern, not a detailed illustration of an actual town.
